rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Nitrogen dominates the atmosphere and refuses to join it. Its inertness is a four-reason argument: the **N≡N triple bond at 941 kJ/mol** (bond length 110 pm), the molecule's **zero dipole moment** (weak grip on reagents), the **complete octets** inside N₂, and hence a purely **kinetic block** — N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃ is thermodynamically downhill yet needs the Haber process's 450 °C, 200 atm and iron to run at all.…

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: "The inertness of nitrogen is due to the very high bond dissociation energy of its triple bond and its non-polar character."

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ***The lithium exception*** — wrap lithium in air and it slowly nitridises at room temperature: the only alkali metal whose nitride's lattice energy pays the triple-bond bill without heat.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — The Triple Bond That Refuses to Break Nitrogen is 78 % of every breath yet almost inert: its N≡N triple bond (941 kJ/mol) is among chemistry's strongest. This topic explains that inertness quantitatively, then shows the two ways chemistry defeats it — the violent "active nitrogen" of the electric discharge and the enzymatic miracle of nitrogen fixation.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts ### 2.1 Occurrence and preparation - **Air:** 78.1 % by volume (N₂); combined: nitrates (Chile saltpetre NaNO₃), ammonium salts, proteins. - **Laboratory:** heating ammonium dichromate (green-route volcano): (NH₄)₂Cr₂O₇ → N₂ + Cr₂O₃ + 4H₂O; or NH₄Cl + NaNO₂ solution warmed: NH₄Cl + NaNO₂ → N₂ + NaCl + 2H₂O.…

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: Inertness is a rate problem, not a stability problem: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃ is downhill in free energy yet blocked for centuries by 941 kJ/mol of bond energy — catalysts and enzymes are the only ways through.

rows.label: Key points

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Rhizobium fixes roughly 100–200 kg of nitrogen per hectare each year in legume fields — free fertiliser, the reason crop rotation with beans is ancient technology.

Common Confusions **Inertness is kinetic, not thermodynamic:** N₂ → NH₃ is thermodynamically favourable (ΔG negative) but kinetically blocked by the triple bond — that distinction is the analytical heart of the answer.  ·  **Active nitrogen is not ionised nitrogen:** it is electronically excited N atoms/molecules from the discharge — no net charge involved.
